name: What are the biggest mistakes in high-end home construction?

mainEntity.name: What mistakes cause the most expensive problems in luxury custom home builds?
mainEntity.text: What mistakes cause the most expensive problems in luxury custom home builds?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most expensive mistakes in luxury construction usually happen early. Underbudgeting is common because owners focus on finishes and overlook site work, consultants, and contingencies. Late selections create schedule delays and force substitutions. Vague scopes produce change orders and disagreements. Poor permit planning can add months to the schedule, especially in complex Los Angeles neighborhoods. Another major mistake is hiring a builder who does not have real experience with custom, high-end work. Luxury homes require more coordination, more precision, and more attention to finish quality than basic residential construction. Homeowners should also avoid making too many design changes after construction has started. The best way to prevent these problems is to use a detailed preconstruction process, choose selections early, and insist on transparent budget and schedule reporting.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest mistakes are underbudgeting, choosing finishes too late, unclear scope, weak permit planning, and hiring a builder without similar luxury experience. These issues often lead to delays, change orders, and quality problems. In high-end construction, poor planning is usually more expensive than good materials.
